components.title: Filter non-cancelled orders
components.what: Include every order whose status is not cancelled, excluding only rows with status cancelled.

components.title: Calculate revenue per order
components.what: For each included order, calculate revenue as units multiplied by unit_price.

components.title: Sum total and North revenue
components.what: Sum revenue across all included orders, and separately sum revenue for included orders whose region is North.

components.title: Compute North percentage
components.what: Calculate North revenue divided by total revenue multiplied by 100, then round the result to one decimal place.

challenges.problem: The quotient is approximately 6.01685%, so 6.0168% is slightly truncated rather than correctly rounded at that precision.

asked: Did any seat reconcile the row count — 17 total rows minus 2 cancelled = 15 non-cancelled — against the per-region item counts actually summed (East 3, South 4, West 6, North 2), confirming every non-cancelled order is used exactly once and none double-counted?
Was the largest line, ORD-1086 (39 x 111.49 = 4348.11), independently recomputed, given that it alone drives roughly a quarter of the denominator and any slip there would move the final percentage?

Is there agreement on the record that pending orders (ORD-1428, ORD-1497, ORD-1518, ORD-1240, ORD-1531) are correctly included, since only cancelled status was excluded, and does the final one-decimal answer 6.0 hold under both the accepted rounding (6.0169%) and the draft's stated 6.0169/6.0168 discrepancy?
replies: Yes. The dataset contains 17 rows. Excluding the 2 cancelled rows (ORD-1478, ORD-1414) leaves exactly 15 non-cancelled rows. Summing the per-region counts (East: 3, South: 4, West: 6, North: 2) yields 3 + 4 + 6 + 2 = 15 rows. Every row in the CSV is mapped to its region and counted exactly once without omissions or double-counting.
Yes. Recomputing ORD-1086 gives 39 × 111.49 = 39 × (111 + 0.49) = 4329 + 19.11 = 4348.11 exactly. The computed figure is verified.

Yes. The prompt specifies "Excluding cancelled orders", which means all non-cancelled orders (both 'shipped' and 'pending') must be included. Pending orders ORD-1428, ORD-1497, ORD-1518, ORD-1240, and ORD-1531 are properly retained. Evaluating 953.27 / 15843.33 gives 0.0601685... (6.01685%), which rounds to 6.0% at one decimal place under standard rounding.
